_about: Permissions (audit C, 2026-09-26): profiles own the safety level, the rule list owns the inventory rule list, per-tool answers are fixed tables; approvals and limits are the inventory rows in groups of four to six.

permissions-profiles.title: Profiles
permissions-profiles.help: Pick how much the assistant may do; the built-in ones cover most needs.

permissions-freedom.title: New runs and chats
permissions-freedom.help: What new work starts with; you can change it for one run.

permissions-freedom-more.title: Who runs the tools
permissions-freedom-more.help: Whether Puppet Master or the agent's own app carries out each action.

permissions-rules-view.title: View and scope
permissions-rules-view.help: Simple or Expert, and which layer's rules you are editing.

permissions-rules.title: Rules, in order
permissions-rules.help: Checked top to bottom; the last matching rule wins.

permissions-tool-answers.title: Answers for each tool
permissions-tool-answers.help: Allow, ask or block each tool and each web ability.

permissions-rules-more.title: Rule details
permissions-rules-more.help: Where rules come from and where they are saved.

permissions-protection.title: File protection
permissions-protection.help: Guards that keep secrets and unplanned files safe.

permissions-commands.title: Dangerous commands
permissions-commands.help: Commands that could wipe files are stopped before they run.

permissions-outside.title: Folders outside the project
permissions-outside.help: What happens when the assistant reaches outside the project.

permissions-redaction.title: Hide secrets
permissions-redaction.help: Scrub keys and personal data from output and screenshots.

permissions-exceptions.title: Exceptions during checks
permissions-exceptions.help: When checks may pass guards that are normally closed.

permissions-pauses.title: When a run stops to ask
permissions-pauses.help: Hands-off, or pause at the checkpoints you pick.

permissions-always-ask.title: Always ask first
permissions-always-ask.help: Actions that need your OK whatever the profile says.

permissions-answering.title: When you're asked
permissions-answering.help: Where requests show up and what your answer does.

permissions-approvals-more.title: Strictness and records
permissions-approvals-more.help: How tightly approvals match, and what is kept.

permissions-runaway.title: Stop runaway work
permissions-runaway.help: Step in when the assistant repeats itself or keeps failing.

permissions-run-limits.title: Limits for one run
permissions-run-limits.help: Caps on money, time and steps for a single run.

permissions-limits-more.title: Finer limits
permissions-limits-more.help: Loop detection style and limits for helpers and steps.
